_help: Copy to points_manual.json (git-ignored, private). Week keys: the platform's own week/epoch number (Variational '45', TxFlow '1' = Epoch 1, Arcus '3'), the week's start date in UTC ('2026-10-19', for QFEX/Entropy tracking weeks that run Monday 00:00 UTC) or its start as unix seconds. Fields: points, rebates (Entropy, USD), volume, pnl, fees, trades; any field you set overrides the computed one. Entered points/rebates are copied into points_ledger.json, so past weeks stay even after you remove them here. pointsTotal / rebatesTotal (optional) override the season total. No platform has a documented points API, so points are entered from each platform's points page after a drop.

variational._capsHelp: weekPnl = PnL since Monday 00:00 UTC, dayPnl = since 00:00 UTC (incl. fees): measured against the $50/week manual reference cap on the Balances tab

_help2: Optional per platform: "bonus": [{"label", "points", "date" or "note"}] for competitions / retroactive / off-schedule distributions (listed in the given order, counted in the season total); "retro": {"label", "points": null = pending}; "profile": {"asOf", "items": [[label, value], ...]} = what the platform's points page shows (rank, tier, totals).

metric.note: TRACKING ONLY. Enter pointsTotal / weeks from app.metric.xyz screenshots. No API.
